title: Rabbi Zakkai of Sha’av
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Chukkat 18, speaking in the name of Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman. A homily of his is found in Bamidbar Rabbah 17:3 and in the Tanchuma addendum to Shelach 18.[^1]

notes.text: The positive Chukat 18 and Appendix to Shelach 18 parallels are in Tanchuma Buber: the former names Zakkai of Sha’av in Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman’s name, the latter contains his homily. Numbers Rabbah 17:3 also names him. Hyman’s unspecific Tanchuma citation is preserved without silently selecting an edition.
